sections.content: Memo 1 (Sales Package)

Date            : 6/11/2025
Project         : Aetas Seputeh
Reference Number: AVALUX-AD-MEMO-SM-2025-009
Subject         : Pricing & Sales Packages, REA Comm & Referral Scheme (15 Jun 2025 to 31 Dec 2025)
1.0 OBJECTIVE

With reference to the above, we would like to seek Management's consideration and approval for the following proposed initiatives, aimed at stimulating demand in lower floors and Block B, enhancing the overall sales performance of Aetas Seputeh:
1. Price Adjustments
2. Proposed Sales Packages
3. REA Sales Commission
4. Referral Scheme
2.0 BACKGROUND
Based on sales status as at 5/5/2025, there are 40 units with SPA signed & 8 units booked out of 126 units at Aetas Seputeh. Sales take up is slow at Block B & across low floors at both blocks.
3.0 PROPOSALS
3.1 LIST PRICE ADJUSTMENTS
To accelerate sales, we propose an overall price adjustment as follows:
a) STANDARD SPA PRICE

ITEM | DESCRIPTION
1. SPA Price adjustments by Block, Unit Type, and Floor Level (Low / Mid / High) | A1: 5%
| A2: 3%
| B1: N/A

2. Recalibrate floor premiums
• RM3,000 per floor
• at level 20: RM50k jump
• at level 30: RM30k jump (as premium units at Tower A are mostly sold)

3. Introduce car park premiums
Using 1 Single + 1 Tandem as the base, add on following premium for additional CP
• Tandem 50,000
• Single Bay 50,000

OVERALL INCREASE IN SPA PRICE        RM14,759,000
b) CURRENT SPA PRICE VS REVISED NEW SPA PRICE
Summary of new SPA price as follows:

* Current SPA price is at the max of 90% EF, this price increase will potentially reduce the loan margin
* Revised SPA price is within the KPKT pricing
c) FOREIGN SPA PRICE (partially furnished packages & 7% agent commission)
• Only applicable for Block B standard units (excluding GB1 & GB2)

To facilitate the 7% commission to agents and partially furnished packages for foreign markets, we will be factoring the costs into the selling price, ensuring margin protection while supporting expansion into high-potential markets such as Singapore, China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan.
Using the standard increased SPA price, we will do a further mark up on each of the unit as and when it is sold to derive its new List Price.

1. 4% to cover agents commission of 7%
2. RM220k to cover partially furnished packages of RM200k
With this mark up, there will be an average of RM62k surplus per unit if we sell to foreigners as compared to our standard packages.
As some of the new List Price will exceed KPKT approval, we will use the Net Price after Discount as SPA Price. (Discount % is the same as the standard unit Rebate %, as per table below)

Units        45
BUA          155,565

REVISED SPA PRICE | REVISED NET PRICE | NET PRICE AFTER AGENT | FOREIGN LIST PRICE | FOREIGN NET PRICE (USED AS SPA PRICE) | FOREIGN NET AFTER AGENT
Please refer to the detailed individual unit Revised SPA Price List including a set of Foreigner List Price List as attached. The Price List will be circulated for management signatory via email.

3.3 REA SALES COMMISSION

To incentivise take-up for Block B – particularly lower floor units – we propose revising the current standard REA commission structure from a flat 3% to a tiered range between 2% to 6%, based on unit type, block, and floor level.
Proposed Agent Commission Scheme (15 Jun 2025 – 31 Dec 2025)

1. 7% Agent Commission for foreign buyer is calculated on net price after discount, and after deducting RM200k for Partially Furnished Package

2. Agent commission payout to remain at 30% upon SPA & balance 70% upon our receipt of Stage 2A
3.4 REFERRAL SCHEME
RM30,000 per successful referral sales for the following categories of introducer:

PROPOSED REFERRAL SCHEME (15 JUN 2025 - 31 DEC 2025)

Category        Current Scheme        Proposed Scheme        Remarks

Guests at Marketing Events        NA        30,000        * Non-buyer category
* Guests must register during our marketing event for record of event attendance.
* Cannot refer own family
* Booking within 2 months from event.
* SPA signing within 21 days
* Payout upon stage 2A
* For agent sales, RM30k will be deducted from Commission
* For internal sales, to monitor to prevent abuse

Business Associates        10,000        30,000        Verification by Procurement / staff working with Business Associates

Staff        15,000        30,000

BGB (Buyer-Get-Buyer)        2%        2%        Company policy (DOE Allocation for 5 units)
4.0 FINANCIAL IMPACT
With the proposals above, there will be an increase in NDV of RM3,556,817 while we maintain the DOE. Summary of Executive Summary as attached.
[PARTIAL]
[UNREADABLE]
The Executive Summary will be circulated for management signatory via email.
5.0 RECOMMENDATION

We trust the above proposals will strengthen the overall sales strategy and accelerate uptake for Aetas Seputeh with an increase in NDV for the project. We would like to seek Management’s Management’s approval to implement these initiatives in order to achieve the sales target for FY2025.
Thank you.
